claims.text: LLMs learn to infer latent concepts during pretraining.
The proposed prompt-response concept model explains how LLMs generate responses.
The proposed prompt-response concept model helps understand the relationship between prompts and response uncertainty.
Response uncertainty decreases as the prompt's informativeness increases.
The relationship between prompt informativeness and uncertainty is similar to epistemic uncertainty.

evidence.description: Detailed experimental results on real-world datasets validate the proposed model showing uncertainty decreases as informativeness increases.
The paper shows that uncertainty decreases as informativeness increases, characterizing it as similar to epistemic uncertainty.

methodologies.name: Prompt-response concept model
methodologies.description: A model that explains response generation and the relationship between prompts and uncertainty by leveraging the idea that LLMs infer latent concepts.

limitations.text: The reliability of LLMs in critical tasks like healthcare is not well-established.
